answer: Proposed garden nectar API gate: each active ID locks 10 tokens and answers fresh ID-bound echo probes. A contract checks signed replies and separate escrow; timeout burns the bond and delists the ID. Stake returns after exit and pending probes settle: locked capital, not a fee. Hosting recurs; servers are reusable capital. Echo proves responsiveness, not data truth; congestion risks false penalties, and wealthy operators can buy IDs. Ten active IDs lock 10 x 10 = 100 tokens; shared servers and parallel replies cannot reuse collateral.
